## setupChecklist-scene-light

```text

Canvas and final export: 1024 x 1024 pixels. No logical card silhouette: this is reusable artwork. Paint bounds x=384,y=128,width=576,height=768. Keep x=0..352 fully transparent. Minimum edge clearance 64 pixels. Genuine RGBA alpha with soft painterly edges; never a checkerboard or opaque paper background.
No text, numbers, letters, charts, rings, buttons, UI symbols or chrome. Subject conveys purpose only, never recorded data, completion or health status.
Palette: surface #FBF3E2, ink #2B2118, secondary #6F6252, warm accent #F0CD87. Assistant violet #6842FF is reserved for Saved Eva Insight.
Illustration: Welcoming doorway. Editorial gouache, soft brush texture, restrained depth and natural edge fade. Warm diffuse lighting.
No typography in production artwork.
Reference images: []

State: deterministic synthetic fixture, never user data. No health conclusions, invented historical charts, completion claims, new assistant identity, logos, watermark, device frame, outside caption or extra panel.
Preserve aspect ratio; never stretch. Record actual generated dimensions. Export by deterministic proportional resampling; regenerate if required cropping removes essential content.
Output: DesignAssets/Sources/HomeCards/setupChecklist-scene-light.png; PNG; alpha required: True.
Acceptance: correct subject and copy, visible complete controls, ambient scene behind native reading field, consistent style, exact final dimensions, alpha verified, no essential cropping.
```

Minimum edge clearance 64 pixels. Genuine RGBA alpha with soft painterly edges; never a checkerboard or opaque paper background.
No text, numbers, letters, charts, rings, buttons, UI symbols or chrome. Subject conveys purpose only, never recorded data, completion or health status.
Palette: surface #FBF3E2, ink #2B2118, secondary #6F6252, warm accent #F0CD87. Assistant violet #6842FF is reserved for Saved Eva Insight.
Illustration: Soft horizon strip. Editorial gouache, soft brush texture, restrained depth and natural edge fade. Warm diffuse lighting.
No typography in production artwork.
Reference images: []

State: deterministic synthetic fixture, never user data. No health conclusions, invented historical charts, completion claims, new assistant identity, logos, watermark, device frame, outside caption or extra panel.
